instructions: Alternate Visual Director strategy informed by the v001 gameplay-read diagnosis and v002 technical proportions failure. Replace the baked PBR patina maps with clear solid color-block materials and distinct roughness/metallic response so the blue tool board, warm timber and galvanized roof separate at the 64-inch Room A presentation camera.
